description_en: Calls the WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries operation to withdraw routing entries that have been published from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or virtual border router (VBR) instance to Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
description_zh: 调用WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries接口撤回专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）或边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）实例已发布至云企业网的路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun cbn withdraw-published-route-entries --cen-id cen-sxjfjkjfkjfiein0000 --child-instance-id vpc-rj9gt5nll27onu70000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g4t0000 --destination-cidr-block 172.16.1.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry to withdraw
parameters.help_zh: 要撤回的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block
